pairs.target: dìliù shítiān bàngwǎn , gòngyòng tīng de mén xièxiàlái yíshàn , kàoqiáng fàng zhe .
pairs.english: At dusk on day sixty, one common-room door leaf stood removed against the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 第六十天傍晚，共用厅的门卸下来一扇，靠墙放着。

pairs.target: búshì huài le . wǎnshàng yǒu gè xiǎo jùhuì , chángdèng yào cóng mén lǐ bānjìn qù , píngrì nà diǎn kuāndù búgòu .
pairs.english: It was not broken. Benches had to be brought inside for an evening gathering; the usual opening was too narrow.
pairs.hanzi: 不是坏了。晚上有个小聚会，长凳要从门里搬进去，平日那点宽度不够。

pairs.target: tǎ wéihé pà wò tái zuìhòu yìzhāng , jìnmén shí gè wǎng yìbiān ràng , dèng jiǎo qiàhǎo kǎ zài ménkuàng shàng , liǎnggè rén tóngshí tíngzhù , yòu tóngshí guài duìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi and Pavo carried the last bench, each moving aside as they entered. A leg caught in the frame; both stopped and blamed the other.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维和帕沃抬最后一张，进门时各往一边让，凳脚恰好卡在门框上，两个人同时停住，又同时怪对方。

pairs.target: yīwén bào zhe yíluò gē zhǐ zhàn zài lǐmiàn , xiào dé téng bù chūshǒu bāngmáng . " nǐ xiān tuì . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: Iven stood inside holding song sheets, laughing too hard to help. “Back up first,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi:
伊文抱着一摞歌纸站在里面，笑得腾不出手帮忙。
“你先退。”塔维说。

pairs.target: " wǒ tuì dào nǎér ? hòumiàn shì rén . " hòumiàn nà rén shuō , kěyǐ xiān jiào tā ràngkāi . tāmen zhè cái bǎ dèngzǐ táijìnqù .
pairs.english: “Where to? Someone's behind me.” That person suggested asking him to move first. At last they got the bench through.
pairs.hanzi:
“我退到哪儿？后面是人。”
后面那人说，可以先叫他让开。他们这才把凳子抬进去。

pairs.target: děng bǎihǎo , tǎ wéi shǒu xīnlǐ liú le yídào mù biān yāchū de yìnzǐ , dǎo bǐ jīntiān liànxí shí fàngsōng .
pairs.english: Once it was placed, a wooden-edge mark remained in Tavi's palm; still, he felt more relaxed than at practice today.
pairs.hanzi: 等摆好，塔维手心里留了一道木边压出的印子，倒比今天练习时放松。

pairs.target: tīnglǐ méiyǒu zuòmǎn , dàjiā suíyì zhàn dìfāng . yǒurén dài chǎo dòu , yǒurén dài yígè quēkǒu de pánzi , pánzi lǐ kōng zhe , shēngchēng dàihuìer zǒnghuì yǒu dōngxī .
pairs.english: The room was not full; people sat wherever they liked. Some brought roasted beans, one a chipped empty plate, claiming something would turn up for it.
pairs.hanzi: 厅里没有坐满，大家随意占地方。有人带炒豆，有人带一个缺口的盘子，盘子里空着，声称待会儿总会有东西。

pairs.english: Two night-duty workers sat by the window, boots unchanged; no one sent them elsewhere.
pairs.hanzi: 窗边坐着两个值夜的工人，靴子还没换，谁也没赶他们去别处。

pairs.english: Mira and Suyi brought sliced radish with salt and crushed fragrant leaves. Pavo tasted a piece and grimaced.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉和苏苡端来一盆切开的萝卜，撒了盐和碎香叶。帕沃尝一块，脸皱起来，

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn tā shìbushì xián búgòu suān , tā máng yáotóu , yìng bǎ dìèrkuài yě chī le .
pairs.english: Mira asked if it was not sour enough. He shook his head hastily and forced down a second piece.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉问他是不是嫌不够酸，他忙摇头，硬把第二块也吃了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài yīwén pángbiān liú le yígè wèizǐ . yīwén què xiān qù zhǎo lǐngchàng de gāoniánjí xuéshēng , liǎng rén duì zhe gē zhǐ dīshēng shuō le hǎo yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Tavi saved Iven a seat beside him, but Iven first went to the senior choir leader; they murmured over the sheets for a while.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在伊文旁边留了一个位子。伊文却先去找领唱的高年级学生，两人对着歌纸低声说了好一会儿。

pairs.target: nàduàn bái jiǎ de cí , zhèhuí pái zài tóng jiē nàduàn hòumiàn . yīwén yǐjīng gēn lǐngchàng liàn guò liǎngcì , bǎ zhuǎndiào de dìfāng lìng chāo chūlái ; búshì jīnwǎn línshí jiāshàng qù de .
pairs.english: The Whitecape verse followed Copperstep's this time. Iven had rehearsed twice with the leader and copied the key change separately; it was not a last-minute addition.
pairs.hanzi: 那段白岬的词，这回排在铜阶那段后面。伊文已经跟领唱练过两次，把转调的地方另抄出来；不是今晚临时加上去的。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhīdào yǐhòu , wèn lǐngchàng néng bunéng bǎ běndì nàduàn de dìèrjù chàng mànxiē , bié bǎ xiūqiáo de rén chàng dé yìkǒuqì jiù pǎo guò sānzuò shān .
pairs.english: Mira asked to slow the local verse's second line, rather than make bridge repairers run over three mountains in one breath.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉知道以后，问领唱能不能把本地那段的第二句唱慢些，别把修桥的人唱得一口气就跑过三座山。

pairs.target: lǐngchàng tīng tā chàng le yíbiàn , nábǐ zài zhǐ shàng zuò le gè jìhào . tā shuō kěyǐ shì , dàn bùzhǔn yì rén mànyìpāi , zuìhòu děng búdào yìqǐ .
pairs.english: The leader listened to her sing, marked the sheet and agreed to try, provided everyone slowed together so the ending still met.
pairs.hanzi: 领唱听她唱了一遍，拿笔在纸上做了个记号。他说可以试，但不准一人慢一拍，最后等不到一起。

pairs.english: They stood by the long window without a stage. The audience turned their benches; one rocked on a short leg, making two sitters brace each other.
pairs.hanzi: 他们站到长窗前，没有台子。厅里的人把凳子转过去，一张凳脚短，转完晃得厉害，坐在上头的两个人只好伸手扶着对方。

pairs.english: Singing began before laughter ended. Tavi had meant only to listen. Remembering his breathless attempt at Whitecape's long ending, he waited for Iven and hummed along.
pairs.hanzi:
歌已经开始，笑还没停。
塔维原想只听。他记得上回自己唱不完白岬那段的长尾音，便等伊文开口，再跟着哼一点。

pairs.target: chàng dào zhuǎntiáo chǔ , lǐngchàng de shǒu wǎng shàng yì tái , hòupái què yǒurén hái liúzài jiù tiáo lǐ . liǎngzhǒng shēngyīn zhuàng dào yìqǐ , yīwén de méitóu yíxià zhòu jǐn .
pairs.english: At the key change the leader lifted his hand, but someone behind stayed in the old key. The voices collided and Iven frowned.
pairs.hanzi: 唱到转调处，领唱的手往上一抬，后排却有人还留在旧调里。两种声音撞到一起，伊文的眉头一下皱紧。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngbùdǒng nǎlǐ cuò le , zhī tīngjiàn pángbiān de pà wò hūrán chàng dé tèbié xiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi could not tell what was wrong, only that Pavo beside him suddenly sang very loudly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听不懂哪里错了，只听见旁边的帕沃忽然唱得特别响。

pairs.target: mǐlā shēnshǒu pāi tā de xīgài , tā hái yǐwéi zài dǎpāizi , yuè chàng yuè yònglì . lǐngchàng zhōngyú tíngxiàlái , wèn hòupái shì nǎwèi dǎsuàn lìng kāi yìtiáo hé .
pairs.english: Mira tapped his knee. Thinking she was keeping time, he sang harder. Finally the leader stopped and asked who in the back intended to open another river.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉伸手拍他的膝盖，他还以为在打拍子，越唱越用力。
领唱终于停下来，问后排是哪位打算另开一条河。

pairs.target: pà wò zhè cái bìzuǐ . tīnglǐ hōngxiào , tā dǎo bù shēngqì , jǔshǒu shuō zìjǐ zhī huì zhè yìzhǒng , ràng tāmen xiān bǎ lìng yìzhǒng jiàowán .
pairs.english: Pavo closed his mouth at last. As laughter filled the room, he raised a hand cheerfully: he knew only this version, so they should finish teaching the other first.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃这才闭嘴。厅里哄笑，他倒不生气，举手说自己只会这一种，让他们先把另一种教完。

pairs.english: Iven lowered his head and took a breath, but slowly smiled. He sang Whitecape's first line alone, softly; after everyone repeated it, he sang the second.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文低头喘了一口气，嘴角却慢慢弯起来。他把白岬的第一句单独唱了一遍，没有唱得很大，等大家跟完，又唱第二句。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tǎ wéi zhōngyú tīngjiàn liǎngduàn nǎlǐ bù yíyàng . bìng búshì bǎ dìmíng huàn le , lù jiù háishì tóng yìtiáo lù .
pairs.english: Now Tavi heard the difference. Changing a place-name did not leave the road unchanged.
pairs.hanzi: 这回塔维终于听见两段哪里不一样。并不是把地名换了，路就还是同一条路。

pairs.english: In one verse people looked up at the bridge; in the other they listened first to water. Even their breathing places differed.
pairs.hanzi: 前一段的人抬头看桥，后一段的人先听水，连停下来换气的地方也不同。

pairs.target: dìèrbiàn cóngtóulái shí , pà wò búzài qiǎng , tǎ wéi què zài wěiyīn shàng duō chēng le yìdiǎn . tā chēng dào zuìhòu háishì méi qì , pángbiān yǒurén tì tā bǎ nà yígè zì chàng wán le .
pairs.english: On the second run, Pavo held back and Tavi stretched the ending longer. He still ran out of breath; someone beside him finished the word.
pairs.hanzi: 第二遍从头来时，帕沃不再抢，塔维却在尾音上多撑了一点。他撑到最后还是没气，旁边有人替他把那一个字唱完了。

pairs.target: tā zhuǎntóu , shì chuāng biān nàge chuān xuēzǐ de gōngrén . duìfāng cháo tā diǎn le yíxiàtóu , réng kànzhe qiánmiàn , fǎngfú tāmen běnlái jiù zài yìqǐ chàng .
pairs.english: He turned: the worker in boots by the window. The man nodded, still looking ahead, as if they had always been singing together.
pairs.hanzi: 他转头，是窗边那个穿靴子的工人。对方朝他点了一下头，仍看着前面，仿佛他们本来就在一起唱。

pairs.target: chàng wán hòu , yīwén méiyǒu lìkè zuò . tā hái qù wèn lǐngchàng , xiàhuí shìbushì néng bǎ zhōngjiān nàge zhuǎnzhé zài liàn yícì . lǐngchàng shuō xiàhuí zhīqián liàn , xiànzài xiān ràng biérén bǎ tāng duān jìnlái .
pairs.english: Afterward Iven asked the leader about rehearsing the transition again next time. Before next time, the leader said; now let people bring the soup.
pairs.hanzi: 唱完后，伊文没有立刻坐。他还去问领唱，下回是不是能把中间那个转折再练一次。领唱说下回之前练，现在先让别人把汤端进来。

pairs.target: tāng pén fàngdào zhuōshàng , nàge kōng pánzi guǒrán yǒu le yòngchu . jǐgè diào zài zhuōmiàn de luóbo kuài bèi jiǎn jìnqù ,
pairs.english: The soup arrived and the empty plate found its use: radish pieces dropped on the table were gathered onto it.
pairs.hanzi: 汤盆放到桌上，那个空盘子果然有了用处。几个掉在桌面的萝卜块被捡进去，

pairs.english: Its owner boasted he had known they would need it. Suyi asked if he had washed it. He abruptly fell silent.
pairs.hanzi: 带盘子的人得意地说早知道缺这个。苏苡看着他，问盘子洗过没有，他一下不说话了。

pairs.target: sàn dé hěn wǎn shí , ménfáng nálái yìzhāng xīn gàoshì , qǐng rén bāngmáng tiē dào tīng wài . shàngmiàn shuō sāntiān hòu běi gōng fāng yǒu dùyùn huìtán , dìsìtiān huì qǐng yíwèi dī dì lái de wéixiū rén dào xuégōng jiǎngkè .
pairs.english: As they dispersed late, the gatekeeper brought a notice to hang outside: ferry talks at the north workshop in three days; a lowland repair worker's school talk the following day.
pairs.hanzi: 散得很晚时，门房拿来一张新告示，请人帮忙贴到厅外。上面说三天后北工坊有渡运会谈，第四天会请一位低地来的维修人到学宫讲课。

pairs.target: yīwén niàn dào dī dì , tǎ wéi biàn còu guòqù . tā wèn nà rén shìbushì yuèjiè kè , ménfáng shuō bù zhīdào , zhī zhīdào duìfāng lái tì zìjǐ de gōng fāng sòng yàngjiàn , háiyào zài chénglǐ mǎi dōngxī .
pairs.english: When Iven read “lowland,” Tavi drew near. Was the visitor an Outrider? The gatekeeper knew only they were delivering workshop samples and shopping in town.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文念到低地，塔维便凑过去。他问那人是不是越界客，门房说不知道，只知道对方来替自己的工坊送样件，还要在城里买东西。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ shèngxià de luóbo zhuāng huí pén lǐ , wèn tǎ wéi tīng bu tīng . tā shuō tīng , suíhòu yòu kàn xiàng yīwén . yīwén bǎ gē zhǐjuàn hǎo , qiāo le qiāo tā de shǒubèi .
pairs.english: Packing the leftover radish, Mira asked whether Tavi would attend. He said yes and looked at Iven, who rolled the song sheets and tapped his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把剩下的萝卜装回盆里，问塔维听不听。他说听，随后又看向伊文。伊文把歌纸卷好，敲了敲他的手背。

pairs.target: " tīng . xiān bǎ nǐ zhàn de dèngzǐ bānchūqù . " tāmen zài tái nà zhāng chángdèng shí , tǎ wéi xiān ràng hòumiàn de rén guò . pà wò zài ménwài gěi tā zhǐlù , hái xiǎoshēng chàng zhe nàtiáo xīnxué de hé . zhè yícì , jìng méi chàng cuò .
pairs.english: “Yes. First carry your bench outside.” This time Tavi let people behind pass before lifting. Pavo guided him from outside, quietly singing the new river. This time, correctly.
pairs.hanzi:
“听。先把你占的凳子搬出去。”
他们再抬那张长凳时，塔维先让后面的人过。帕沃在门外给他指路，还小声唱着那条新学的河。这一次，竟没唱错。
